entities.summary: Christian Lollike is a Danish playwright, theater director and artistic director of Sort/Hvid in Copenhagen. Lollike is working with stage and installation art in theaters, public areas and virtual platforms. He has made theater, film, musicvideo, opera, dance and art interventions. He often uses current political events in his work.
